findings.evidence: Symmetry.lean:271-280 `noncomputable def geckLieEquiv ... := LieEquiv.ofSubalgebras ...` / `theorem geckLieEquiv_apply ...`; Symmetry.lean:330-338 `noncomputable def geckLieAut ... := geckLieEquiv g τ hτ` and `theorem geckLieAut_apply ... := geckLieEquiv_apply g τ hτ x`.
findings.fix: Delete the `Automorphism` section (`geckLieAut`, `geckLieAut_apply`) and have callers use `geckLieEquiv g τ hτ : lieAlgebra b ≃ₗ⁅R⁆ lieAlgebra b` at `P₂ := P`; if a name for the automorphism case is wanted it must carry content (e.g. a monoid hom `P.Aut → (lieAlgebra b ≃ₗ⁅R⁆ lieAlgebra b)`), not a re-export.
findings.issue: `geckLieAut` is definitionally `geckLieEquiv g τ hτ` with `P₂ := P`, `b₂ := b` (its body is literally `geckLieEquiv g τ hτ`), and `geckLieAut_apply` (line 335) is proved by `geckLieEquiv_apply g τ hτ x` — two wrapper declarations that add nothing over the declarations 60 lines above.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/WeylGroup.lean:163 `abbrev weylGroupToPerm := (Equiv.indexHom P).domRestrict P.weylGroup`; TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Weyl/Group.lean:160-174 vs EquivInvariance.lean:82-89 (identical statement modulo `RootPairing.indexNeg_neg`).

findings.evidence: Symmetry.lean:223-225, 233-235, 243-245: each `reindex_*` proof is `rw [coe_reindexAlgEquiv, ← submatrix_geckIndexEquiv_* g τ hτ i, reindex_apply, submatrix_submatrix]; simp`; grep shows `submatrix_geckIndexEquiv_` occurs only in those three proofs and its own statements.
findings.fix: Delete `submatrix_geckIndexEquiv_{h,e,f}` and prove the `reindex_*` lemmas directly by the same `ext` / `rcases` / `simp only` computation (they currently differ only by `rw [coe_reindexAlgEquiv, reindex_apply, submatrix_submatrix]; simp`), or keep only the `submatrix_*` form if a `Fintype`-free consumer is actually added.
findings.issue: `submatrix_geckIndexEquiv_{h,e,f}` (lines 169, 183, 199) and `reindex_geckIndexEquiv_{h,e,f}` (lines 220, 230, 240) are the same three facts in two public forms, related by `Matrix.reindex_apply` + `submatrix_submatrix`; the `submatrix_*` form has no consumer other than the `reindex_*` proofs it feeds, so the weaker-instance justification in its docstring buys nothing in-repo.

summary: The invariance lemmas and the Geck reindexing are genuinely new relative to Mathlib and TauCeti, but the PR ships a bare alias (geckLieAut = geckLieEquiv), leaves the pre-existing special case TauCeti.RootPairing.weylGroupToPerm_neg re-deriving what the new indexEquiv_neg proves, and exports two parallel three-lemma families (submatrix_* and reindex_*) for the same fact.
